ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40% high-intensity (white) pixels localized to the lateral lobes versus 60% low-intensity (black/grey) pixels concentrated in the central and basal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the distal third of both lobes. The right lobe features a solid white patch with feathered interior edges. The left lobe displays a similar white patch with higher-frequency black mottling (speckling) at the transition zone. The central 'V' region and peduncle attachment area are solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate vertex angle of 110 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration across the entire trailing edge. High-frequency, low-amplitude peaks are visible along the mid-lobe sections, while the distal tips show high-amplitude, irregular protrusions corresponding to calcified buildup.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve extending from the median notch, transitioning to a sharp upward taper at the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, 3D clusters of calcified organisms (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical high-intensity white streaks on the dark pigment of the right lobe, and diagonal low-intensity dark streaks crossing the white patch on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle colonization at the terminal ends of both fluke lobes, causing visible deformation of the smooth edge contour.
other_distinctive_markers: Faint, circular, flower-shaped pigment patterns visible in the low-intensity dark region of the central-left lobe.
